name: Canada Yew
desc: Canada Yew (Taxus canadensis): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 36 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Taxus canadensis, the Canada yew or Canadian yew, is a conifer in the family Taxaceae, native to central and eastern North America, thriving in swampy woods, ravines, riverbanks and on lake shores.
